version: as described in DEN200026, granted 15 June 2020

claims.text: Improves attention function as measured by computer-based testing (TOVA API) in children aged 8 to 12 with ADHD.

source.passage: this study provides evidence that AKL-T01 might be used to improve objectively measured inattention in paediatric patients with ADHD

claims.population: aged 8-12 years, without disorder-related medications, confirmed ADHD, TOVA API -1.8 and below

source.passage: may not display benefits in typical behavioral symptoms, such as hyperactivity.
